The 20 October 2026 manuscript-use approval concerns the frozen [historical A7 record](../results/a7-paper-evidence/README.md), `e234e860…` at MEA association volume 0.036287. The [current record](../notebook.qmd#working-record), `00e77608…` at association volume 0.036305439, was adopted under #215 on 24 October; independent delivered review and investigator promotion for manuscript use remain pending.

# Question

Which scientific limits remain after the adopted A7 evidence and the completed prerequisite work?

# Result

Four questions remain: the warm loaded-density disagreement, parameter identification and uncertainty, the phase and concentration domain, and source transfer.

# Basis and method

Use the retained A7 uncertainty, source limits and assessment records to identify what is unresolved. A closed implementation issue does not remove a stated scientific limitation.

# Values

| Remaining question | Existing evidence and limit |
| --- | --- |
| Warm loaded-density disagreement | [Overview density comparison](../notebook.qmd#density-and-heat-capacity): failures remain disclosed; Amundsen’s source-uncertainty boundary is unresolved. |
| Parameter identification and uncertainty | [Conditional errors](../notebook.qmd#fitted-coordinates) condition on weights, fixed inputs, bounds and local linearization. |
| Phase and concentration domain | [A7 assessment](../joint-recalibration/index.qmd): finite phase evidence and named transfer comparisons do not qualify a process model. |
| Source transfer | [Neutral CO₂ study](../neutral-co2/index.qmd): historical representation and campaign-transfer qualifications remain attached to their results. |

# Limits and evidence type

The questions above delimit the retained calibration and numerical evidence; they do not establish process-use qualification.
